name: Bad Lotion
source:
The boss of the "Lotions," a gang ruling the magic city's slums.
This former working girl played her cards right, climbing from rock bottom to the top of the heap.

Starting as a brothel worker, she charmed her way up, eventually becoming the gang's leader.
She thinks she's the hottest thing since sliced bread and loves being fawned over by her loyal minions. But she's got no love for men, looking down on them with disgust. Even her own crew isn't safe from her wrath when she's in a bad mood.

Superpower
"Living, breathing slime factory"
She oozes a special goo that she can shape and control, from watery to rubber-like.
This slippery skill has more uses than you can shake a stick at - from bedroom shenanigans to taking down enemies.
She's not a bottomless well, though - she needs to chow down regularly to keep her goo reserves topped up.
